About A New Day

A New Day is a privacy-first daily checklist designed to support people rebuilding routines. Tasks live solely on your device, and the list resets automatically at local midnight so you can focus on today.

The app provides optional encrypted backups, offline access, and keyboard-friendly interactions to help you move through your routine with confidence. If you have ideas that would make this tool more accessible, we’d love to hear from you.

Reminder: This application is a self-guided aid and does not replace professional or emergency support. If you ever feel unsafe, contact local services immediately.
